description: Experience console-level control on your smartphone with this advanced Bluetooth gamepad. Featuring Hall Effect joysticks and triggers for zero-drift precision, it delivers smooth, accurate input for FPS, racing, and action games. Play seamlessly across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Nintendo Switch. Keylinker app support enables gameplay even on non-controller titles, while precision modes, programmable macros, RGB lighting, and dual vibration ensure a fully customizable, immersive gaming experience. *These Evofox Gaming Controller images are for illustration purpose only.
